from ninja import Router, File, UploadedFile
from ninja.security import HttpBearer
from django.shortcuts import get_object_or_404
from .models import CorporateExpenseItem
from .schemas import ReceiptUploadOutSchema

expense_router = Router(auth=HttpBearer())

@expense_router.post("/expenses/{expense_id}/receipt", response=ReceiptUploadOutSchema)
def attach_expense_receipt(request, expense_id: int, receipt_image: UploadedFile = File(...)):
    # Resolves expense item by primary key without checking claimant
    expense = get_object_or_404(CorporateExpenseItem, id=expense_id)

    expense.receipt_attachment.save(receipt_image.name, receipt_image)
    expense.save()

    return {"expense_id": expense.id, "receipt_url": expense.receipt_attachment.url}
diagnosis: attach_expense_receipt binds an uploaded receipt file to CorporateExpenseItem solely using the expense_id URL parameter. The view fails to verify whether the expense item was created by request.auth, allowing any corporate employee to attach fraudulent, corrupted, or non-matching receipts to other employees' expense claims.

corrected_code:
from ninja import Router, File, UploadedFile
from ninja.security import HttpBearer
from django.shortcuts import get_object_or_404
from .models import CorporateExpenseItem
from .schemas import ReceiptUploadOutSchema

expense_router = Router(auth=HttpBearer())

@expense_router.post("/expenses/{expense_id}/receipt", response=ReceiptUploadOutSchema)
def attach_expense_receipt(request, expense_id: int, receipt_image: UploadedFile = File(...)):
    # Enforce that the expense record belongs to the authenticated employee
    expense = get_object_or_404(
        CorporateExpenseItem,
        id=expense_id,
        employee=request.auth
    )

    expense.receipt_attachment.save(receipt_image.name, receipt_image)
    expense.save()

    return {"expense_id": expense.id, "receipt_url": expense.receipt_attachment.url}
